title: Documents and records
summary: Keep important originals protected and make readable backup copies.
steps: Collect the IDs, insurance information, medical records, and other documents that matter to your household.
Put sensitive digital copies in a tested encrypted vault. Keep its password and recovery key separate from the drive.
Store original documents safely; a digital copy may not satisfy a specific agency's requirements.
Test opening a backup copy on another device and keep a second encrypted copy elsewhere.
